assessment_scope: Mosquitto, Eclipse Ditto and InfluxDB; CVE-2018-12546 and CVE-2018-12551 only

research_decisions.decision: For an order-preserving step with cve_ids set to an empty list, the frozen material does not define separate A or G evidence semantics. A and G are kept UNKNOWN and do not inherit B, H, K or Y.
The proposed Ditto-to-InfluxDB write is represented as DF with no additional CVE. Its relationship remains UNKNOWN until an actual write is verified.

The controlled normal non-retained message establishes only the observed Mosquitto-to-Ditto data path and authorized Ditto receiver processing. It does not establish CVE-specific transition capability, retained affected-data processing, target C/I/A impact, or attack feasibility.

The controlled MQTT-to-Ditto-to-InfluxDB normal telemetry run proves both transport links only during the tested configuration. It does not upgrade restored baseline relationships or CVE-specific downstream effects.
